notes.title: DEMO
notes.notes: Dive into the puzzle-platformer excitement of Frog Story: The Powerful Tongue Demo Version! Explore the intricately designed World 1, featuring 24 stages packed with brain-teasing challenges and heart-pounding action. Traverse through enchanting landscapes and cunningly crafted obstacles, utilizing your powerful tongue to overcome each puzzle that awaits. Can you unravel the mysteries of every stage and emerge victorious? Get ready to leap into adventure – your froggy destiny awaits!
